appDescription: Finds second-hand items for sale near the driver's route and lets the driver stop by after the seller accepts.

function.name: ADD_INTEREST
function.description: Adds an item the driver wants to buy to the interest list so matching listings near the route are announced.

keyword.description: The item the driver wants to buy.

goLevel.description: How far the driver is willing to detour for it.

function.name: ANSWER_ALERT
function.description: Answers the stop-by question currently shown on screen with yes or no, or with the item name when two items are offered.

item.description: The item to choose when the app offers two items.

function.name: ASK_ABOUT_LISTINGS
function.description: Answers the driver's question about the second-hand listings along the current route and can pick one on request. The app answers aloud in Korean.

question.description: The driver's question or instruction about the listings, in their own words.
